patch.value: MCP pm_health defaults to the compact summary projection for token-efficient agent health checks

MCP pm_health returned the full ~12.8KB payload by default unlike pm_list/pm_search (compact-by-default). Now defaults to the summary projection (~22x smaller: ok + per-check status + warning samples); callers opt into the deep remediation payload via full=true. Found by agent-UX audit (F2).
Shipped: MCP pm_health defaults to summary projection; full=true opts into detail. Locked with mcp-handshake tests.
